The argument of learned prosecutor that the accused/applicants were evasive in their interrogation cannot be a ground to deny them liberty.
It is the investigatorial skills of the investigator which matter.
If the interrogator is unable to elicit the requisite information in the course of interrogation, the accused joining investigation cannot be faulted with.
No accused is under a duty not to be smart.
